style.backgroundSystem: ice-mint watercolor-botanical panels #EAF5F3 and warm paper white #F7F5F1 for info screens, warm mist grey studio backdrop #ECEAE7 for packshots, deep teal banner tone #17323B reserved for mood and closing strips
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and numbered circles only, in deep teal #245B57 or aqua #4E9A93
style.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, clean water-splash accents on benefit shots
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh botanical skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ice-mint white #EAF5F3, warm mist grey #ECEAE7, deep teal text #245B57 and one aqua accent #4E9A93, with a deep teal banner tone #17323B reserved for mood and closing strips; bright soft diffused studio lighting with a front-left key, soft contact shadows and clean water-splash accents; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep teal with wide letter-spaced caption lines; consistent thin-line icon style in deep teal; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal watercolor-botanical and infographic elements; stable upright product presentation at a slight 3/4 hero angle with consistent scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no logo or brand marks anywhere
style.presentationRules: product always upright at a stable slight 3/4 hero angle with consistent scale; water splash allowed only at the product base; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E7E2DC, matte warm-grey board #ECEAE7, warm paper board #F7F5F1
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep teal #245B57 with wide letter-spaced caption lines, all copy wrapped in 「」; no serif or handwritten mixing; aqua #4E9A93 reserved for numbered circles, connectors and small badges
